    cards.list read

    GET /api/v1/envs/{env}/cards MCP cards_list

    List DevOps cards

    Board cards in board order. Filters: column, project (id, name or "none"), label (id or name), assignee (person id or name), agent (AgentFlow agent: cards delegated to it), q ("#12" or title text), hideDone.

    Input

    FieldTypeDescription
    envstringrequiredEnvironment id (see envs.list).
    columnstringBoard column: requests (Requests / Sprinted), doing (Doing), blocked (Blocked), uat (UAT), done (Done), must (Backlog: Must Have), nice (Backlog: Nice to Have). One of requests, doing, blocked, uat, done, must, nice.
    projectstringProject id or name, or "none".
    labelstringLabel id or name.
    assigneestringPerson node id or name.
    agentstringAgentFlow agent id or name: cards delegated to it.
    qstring
    hideDoneboolean
    limitintegerPage size (1-200, default 50).
    cursorstringnextCursor from the previous page.
    JSON Schema
    {
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "env": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9-]{1,64}$",
      "description": "Environment id (see envs.list)."
    },
    "column": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "requests",
        "doing",
        "blocked",
        "uat",
        "done",
        "must",
        "nice"
      ],
      "description": "Board column: requests (Requests / Sprinted), doing (Doing), blocked (Blocked), uat (UAT), done (Done), must (Backlog: Must Have), nice (Backlog: Nice to Have)."
    },
    "project": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 200,
      "description": "Project id or name, or \"none\"."
    },
    "label": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 200,
      "description": "Label id or name."
    },
    "assignee": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 200,
      "description": "Person node id or name."
    },
    "agent": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 200,
      "description": "AgentFlow agent id or name: cards delegated to it."
    },
    "q": {
      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 200
    },
    "hideDone": {
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 200,
      "default": 50,
      "description": "Page size (1-200, default 50)."
    },
    "cursor": {
      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 200,
      "description": "nextCursor from the previous page."
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "env"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}

    cards.create write

    POST /api/v1/envs/{env}/cards MCP cards_create

    Create a DevOps card

    Add a card (it gets the next #number). Lands in Requests / Sprinted unless column says otherwise. References (project, labels, assignees, item) are ids or names; unknown ones are refused with 400.

    Input

    FieldTypeDescription
    envstringrequiredEnvironment id (see envs.list).
    columnstringBoard column: requests (Requests / Sprinted), doing (Doing), blocked (Blocked), uat (UAT), done (Done), must (Backlog: Must Have), nice (Backlog: Nice to Have). One of requests, doing, blocked, uat, done, must, nice.
    titlestringrequired
    descriptionstring
    projectstringProject id or name; "" for none.
    labelsstring[]
    pointsnumber | null
    duestringYYYY-MM-DD, or "" for none.
    assigneesobject[]
    assignees[].nodestringrequiredA person on a chart: node id or name.
    assignees[].roleenumOne of developer, tester, requester.
    checklistobject[]
    checklist[].idstring
    checklist[].textstringrequired
    checklist[].doneboolean
    linksobject[]
    links[].idstring
    links[].kindenumOne of pr, commit, url.
    links[].urlstringrequired
    itemstringTimeline item id or title; "" for none.
    agentsstring[]Delegate the card to these agents (replaces the list; [] for none). It joins each one's work queue (agents.work).
    JSON Schema
    {
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "env": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9-]{1,64}$",
      "description": "Environment id (see envs.list)."
    },
    "column": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "requests",
        "doing",
        "blocked",
        "uat",
        "done",
        "must",
        "nice"
      ],
      "description": "Board column: requests (Requests / Sprinted), doing (Doing), blocked (Blocked), uat (UAT), done (Done), must (Backlog: Must Have), nice (Backlog: Nice to Have)."
    },
    "title": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 200
    },
    "description": {
      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 8000
    },
    "project": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 0,
      "maxLength": 200,
      "description": "Project id or name; \"\" for none."
    },
    "labels": {
      "type": "array",
      "maxItems": 50,
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "minLength": 1,
        "maxLength": 200,
        "description": "Label id or name."
      }
    },
    "points": {
      "type": [
        "number",
        "null"
      ],
      "minimum": 0,
      "maximum": 1000
    },
    "due": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^(\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2})?$",
      "description": "YYYY-MM-DD, or \"\" for none."
    },
    "assignees": {
      "type": "array",
      "maxItems": 20,
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "node": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1,
            "maxLength": 200,
            "description": "A person on a chart: node id or name."
          },
          "role": {
            "enum": [
              "developer",
              "tester",
              "requester"
            ],
            "default": "developer"
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "node"
        ],
        "additionalProperties": false
      }
    },
    "checklist": {
      "type": "array",
      "maxItems": 200,
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "id": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "text": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1,
            "maxLength": 300
          },
          "done": {
            "type": "boolean"
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "text"
        ],
        "additionalProperties": false
      }
    },
    "links": {
      "type": "array",
      "maxItems": 50,
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "id": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "kind": {
            "enum": [
              "pr",
              "commit",
              "url"
            ]
          },
          "url": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1,
            "maxLength": 500
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "url"
        ],
        "additionalProperties": false
      }
    },
    "item": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 0,
      "maxLength": 200,
      "description": "Timeline item id or title; \"\" for none."
    },
    "agents": {
      "type": "array",
      "maxItems": 20,
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "minLength": 1,
        "maxLength": 200,
        "description": "AgentFlow agent id or name."
      },
      "description": "Delegate the card to these agents (replaces the list; [] for none). It joins each one's work queue (agents.work)."
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "env",
    "title"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}

    cards.update write

    PATCH /api/v1/envs/{env}/cards/{card} MCP cards_update

    Update a DevOps card

    Change a card's fields. Lists you send (labels, assignees, checklist, links) replace the old ones. The column only changes through cards.move, which applies the board's gates.

    Input

    FieldTypeDescription
    envstringrequiredEnvironment id (see envs.list).
    cardstring | integerrequiredCard number or id.
    titlestring
    descriptionstring
    projectstringProject id or name; "" for none.
    labelsstring[]
    pointsnumber | null
    duestringYYYY-MM-DD, or "" for none.
    assigneesobject[]
    assignees[].nodestringrequiredA person on a chart: node id or name.
    assignees[].roleenumOne of developer, tester, requester.
    checklistobject[]
    checklist[].idstring
    checklist[].textstringrequired
    checklist[].doneboolean
    linksobject[]
    links[].idstring
    links[].kindenumOne of pr, commit, url.
    links[].urlstringrequired
    itemstringTimeline item id or title; "" for none.
    agentsstring[]Delegate the card to these agents (replaces the list; [] for none). It joins each one's work queue (agents.work).
    JSON Schema
    {
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "env": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9-]{1,64}$",
      "description": "Environment id (see envs.list)."
    },
    "card": {

          }
        },

      }
    },
    "item": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 0,
      "maxLength": 200,
      "description": "Timeline item id or title; \"\" for none."
    },
    "agents": {
      "type": "array",
      "maxItems": 20,
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "minLength": 1,

      "description": "Delegate the card to these agents (replaces the list; [] for none). It joins each one's work queue (agents.work)."

  },
  "required": [

    cards.move write

    POST /api/v1/envs/{env}/cards/{card}/move MCP cards_move

    Move a DevOps card

    Move a card to a column (and position: index among that column's other cards; end if left out). The board's gates apply: into Done needs confirm: true, or approve: true from UAT (the Approve button); out of Done needs confirm: true; into Doing without a developer needs developer (a person, who is assigned) or confirm: true to leave it unassigned. A refused gate is 409 with code confirm_done, confirm_reopen or pick_developer.

    Input

    FieldTypeDescription
    envstringrequiredEnvironment id (see envs.list).
    cardstring | integerrequiredCard number or id.
    columnstringrequiredBoard column: requests (Requests / Sprinted), doing (Doing), blocked (Blocked), uat (UAT), done (Done), must (Backlog: Must Have), nice (Backlog: Nice to Have). One of requests, doing, blocked, uat, done, must, nice.
    indexinteger
    confirmboolean
    approveboolean
    developerstringPerson node id or name.
    JSON Schema
    {
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "env": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9-]{1,64}$",
      "description": "Environment id (see envs.list)."
    },
    "card": {
      "type": [
        "string",
        "integer"
      ],
      "description": "Card number or id."
    },
    "column": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "requests",
        "doing",
        "blocked",
        "uat",
        "done",
        "must",
        "nice"
      ],
      "description": "Board column: requests (Requests / Sprinted), doing (Doing), blocked (Blocked), uat (UAT), done (Done), must (Backlog: Must Have), nice (Backlog: Nice to Have)."
    },
    "index": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 0
    },
    "confirm": {
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "approve": {
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "developer": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 200,
      "description": "Person node id or name."
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "env",
    "card",
    "column"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}
